title: Implement a Kafka producer that publishes an order-created event, and a @KafkaListener consumer that processes it
hint: Use KafkaTemplate.send() with the order ID as the key in the producer, and annotate the consumer method with @KafkaListener specifying topic and groupId.

title: Implement retry-with-backoff and Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) handling for a consumer that fails processing
hint: Configure DefaultErrorHandler with an ExponentialBackOff and a DeadLetterPublishingRecoverer so records failing after retries go to a DLT topic.

title: Implement an idempotent consumer that safely handles duplicate delivery of the same message (dedup by message key/ID)
hint: Persist the processed message ID (unique constraint) or check a store before handling, so duplicates are skipped and processing plus recording happens atomically.

title: Implement manual offset commit after successful processing, instead of relying on auto-commit
hint: Set enable.auto.commit to false and AckMode MANUAL, inject Acknowledgment into the listener, and call acknowledge() only after processing succeeds.

title: Implement an event-ordering-sensitive consumer that processes events for the same entity (e.g., same order ID) strictly in order
hint: Use the entity ID as the message key so all its events land on one partition, and keep a single consumer thread per partition without async reordering.

title: Implement retry topics and a dead-letter topic with Spring Kafka, including non-retryable exceptions
hint: Use @RetryableTopic with attempts and backoff, a @DltHandler method, and exclude or notRetryOn for exceptions that should go straight to the DLT.

title: Implement a transactional outbox with a polling publisher
hint: Write the business row and an outbox row in one transaction, then have a scheduled poller publish unsent rows to Kafka and mark them sent.
